```plato
    // The load vector of the discretised beam.
    BeamLoadVector(b: Beam, elementCount: Integer): Array<Number>
        => b.Loads.FlatMap(load => load.LoadContributions(b, elementCount))
            .ScatterLoads((elementCount + 1) * 2);
```
